verdicts.strongest_argument: Every factual element of this claim is both in the captured wire copy and visibly in the price bars, and the hunter concedes it. The NXP approach story is the Stocktwits item stored at docs/e808353b7437f49012697a68c61216614bf5594a.txt and surfaced in snapshots/20260830T084033Z.json; quote.json shows the market pricing it twice in enormous volume - 67.01 on 2026-06-29 to 85.80 on 06-30 on 7.0m shares against a ~1.0m 20-day average, then 74.09 to 86.00 on 07-31 on 9.2m shares - and then unpricing it just as visibly, 86.78 on 08-07 down to the 66-69 area by 09-01/09-02 with volume normalising to 0.9-1.3m. That is the definition of a fact the tape has already absorbed. What remains is not a fact but an interpretation: that an undenied approach at an implied ~$77 creates a downside cushion the 16.8% median reaction overstates. No dated source in the capture says that, and it is precisely the shape of argument the instructions warn about - reading the run-up, here the fade, and asserting a distributional consequence. The insider-filing cadence gap is real in filings.json but is a Form 4 absence with an equally ordinary blackout explanation, and nothing in the snapshots draws any implication from it, so it sits in the reachable-but-unconnected band and cannot carry the claim. Two further weaknesses: the claim's own price path is mis-specified - there were two distinct pops, 06-30 and 07-31, not one - and a takeover-floor argument is a claim about the shape of the reaction rather than its direction, so it cannot rank this name against others on a signed scale.

prior_publication.what_it_says: Reports the NXP buyout talks and the 18% move they caused, i.e. the approach and its size were public wire copy five weeks before the print.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: quote.json: 06-30 close 85.80 on 7,006,800 shares and 07-31 close 86.00 on 9,207,200 shares versus avg_volume_20d 1,044,905 - the rumour was priced in two of the largest volume bars in the series. The fade is equally in the bars: 86.78 (08-07) to 67.14 (09-02), with baseline spot 63.38, run_up_5d -10.93%, run_up_20d -24.36%. The deal-value discount the claim points at is an output of price action already in the baseline, not new information.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: A dated item in the capture showing the approach was still live and progressing into September - a second request, an exclusivity report, a 13D/G change - rather than an inference from a Form 4 gap.
